result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and spacing are unchecked.

- **Layout:** The page is white, centered in one column up to 1120px wide, with 48px of space above it. The heading "New request" is on the left. Cancel and Create Request are on the right, because DESIGN.md puts the screen's one primary action in the top row. The fields sit in a single bordered card.
- **Fields:** Title and Description each span the full width. Priority, Assignee and Due date share one row of three. Priority starts on Medium and Assignee on Maya Chen, so neither select opens blank.
- **Buttons:** Cancel is the quiet style and Create Request is the ink-filled primary.
- **Tokens:** Everything follows the DESIGN.md tokens. I inlined only the tokens it uses into a `<style>` block, so the file stands alone.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as assets here, so the text falls back to the system font.
